query: Map the features of this application.
setup: Monorepo: Express API under apps/api/src/routes/*.ts, React web app under apps/web/src with Feature-Sliced Design folders (app, pages, widgets, features, entities, shared)
A BullMQ worker registers two queues in apps/api/src/jobs/
LaunchDarkly client is installed; three flags are read via ldClient.variation() in apps/web/src/shared/config/flags.ts and one directly inside a route handler
expected_behavior: Detects both the API and web packages and lists http-route, screen, and job as entrypoint kinds before harvesting
Finds every route handler, every page, and both queue consumers; does not list only the web pages
Groups features under capabilities derived from route prefixes and FSD slices, and marks the grouping of any feature it could not attribute as AMBIGUOUS
Reports all four LaunchDarkly flags in a Flags section with key, provider, default, read location, and impacted features
Writes docs/feature-map.md following the template: meta comment with git sha, mindmap overview, one capability section per capability, a feature table, and per-feature detail blocks
Contains no recommendations, refactoring advice, or quality judgments
Asks at most one round of questions, limited to AMBIGUOUS items
